reviews.reason: The opening across PDF108 and PDF110 supports አፈው, north (ለመስዕ), and the asterisk between ወ and the cinnamon term. However, PDF110’s aromatic-list glyphs do not securely support the supplied transcription: the nard opening appears ስ rather than ሰ, and the cinnamon sequence appears ቅንኣ… rather than ቀናን…. The pepper vowel forms also remain unresolved. These are main-text questions at apparatus references 3, 6, and 7; accepting an unchanged source record would overstate verification. Do not substitute apparatus variants or the Greek plant list.
reviews.suggested_text: And after these aromatics, looking north[a] over the mountains, I saw seven mountains full of choice nard[b] and fragrant trees, cinnamon, and pepper.[c]
reviews.footnote_changes: The proposed note anchors are appropriate. Retain the distinction between the selected Geʽez direction and Greek comparison evidence, the botanical uncertainty, and the editorial asterisk; make no modern-species identification.
